text: 1AIII කොˁොටස - ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ අති විශෙˤෂ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය - 2025.01.08பகுதி III - இலங்கைச் சனநாயக சோசலிசக் குடியரசு வர்த்தமானப் பத்திரிகை - அதி விசேஷமானது - 2025.01.08
ශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රිශ්‍රී ලංංකාා ප්‍රජාාතාාන්ත්‍රික සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රයක සමාාජවාාදී ජනරජයේɏ ගැැසට් පත්‍රය
අති විශෙˤෂඅති විශෙˤෂThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

BIBILE PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER the regulations made in the series of directives regarding “the planning and systematic arrangement of roads and narrow paths maintained by Pradeshiya Sabhas of Uva Province and the publication of notifications showing the name list” published by the Hon. Governor of Uva Province through Extraordinary Gazette No. 2318/41 dated February 10, 2023, and Extraordinary Gazette No. 2414/13 dated December 11, 2024, and under the regulation made by Section 24(1) of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act, No. 15 of 1987, among the roads and narrow paths that were considered to belong to Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha as included in the schedule of the notification published in Gazette No. 2416/28 dated December 27, 2024: Roads and narrow paths for which no case has been filed in a competent court before the date specified in that notification, and Roads and narrow paths for which a case was filed in a competent court before that date, and which the court has confirmed through its judgment should belong to the Pradeshiya Sabha. All such roads and narrow paths shall belong to Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha, as approved on 28 day of May 2025 under No. 225 and this is hereby published for public information. A name list of the said roads and narrow paths is included in the schedule hereto, and it is further notified that each and every road and narrow path included therein should be considered as roads and narrow paths belonging to Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha under Sub-section (5) of Section 24 of the Pradeshiya Sabha Act.
D. M. Anusha S. Dissanayaka, Secretary, Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha.
At Bibile Pradeshiya Sabha Office,28th of May, 2025.
This Gazette Extraordinary can be downloaded from www.documents.gov.lk
